// GREEN fixture for `residency-pin` — the STORAGE-relevant slice (P-ST-04 / P-020). The lint MUST
// admit this. A caller opens the real `myelin-storage` OLTP store with its `Region` PINNED on the
// same construction statement — no global pool; the data stays inside its residency boundary
// (ADR-11). This is the region-pinned write the lint admits.
pub async fn open_tenant_store(config: OltpConfig, region: Region, minter: Arc<dyn IdMinter>) -> ColocatedOltp {
    ColocatedOltp::open(config.region(region), minter).unwrap()
}
